While modern English translations have been produced by Bhikkhu Sujato and Ayya Soma, alongside translations into nine other languages [SuttaCentral], the text is not directly analyzed in the retrieved secondary literature; instances of *aññatara* or *aññatarā* found in the reference passages merely represent the common Pali indefinite pronoun occurring across other Vinaya, sutta, and commentarial contexts.
